builder: Ace Tone / Ace Electronic Industries Inc.
model_or_product: Fuzz Master FM-1; Fuzz Master FM-2; Fuzz Master FM-3; Twin Ace FW-1; Wah Master WM-1
evidence_summary: Ace Tone was founded in Osaka in 1960 by Ikutaro Kakehashi and is documented as a manufacturer of electronic musical instruments, amplifiers and effects pedals. Its dirt catalog includes the FM-1, FM-2 and FM-3 Fuzz Master models, plus the Twin Ace FW-1 fuzz/wah. Recent archival research places the FM-2 introduction as early as March 1968 and documents its continued catalog presence through at least 1979. Preserve Ace Tone as the manufacturer lineage and do not merge it into later Roland/BOSS merely because Kakehashi founded Roland in 1972.

Effects Database identifies the Montarbo Sinfhoton as an Italian fuzz/distortion pedal introduced in 1968 and associated directly with Montarbo, an established Italian amplifier/PA/effects manufacturer. Because the production-period and broader pedal catalog need stronger independent archival confirmation, retain Montarbo as research-only for now rather than promoting it to a fully validated commercial pedal manufacturer record.
